scripts.docs:sdk:python: python3 -m pip install -q pdoc && PYTHONPATH=sdks/python/src python3 -m pdoc -o docs/sdk/python notification_hub
scripts.docs:api: tsoa spec && tsx scripts/enrich-swagger-examples.ts && tsx scripts/swagger-docs.ts
scripts.docs:api:site: tsoa spec && tsx scripts/enrich-swagger-examples.ts && tsx scripts/build-swagger-ui-static.ts

scriptsComments.docs:sdk: Build TypeScript/Java/Python SDK reference sites into docs/sdk/{typescript,java,python}/ plus index
scriptsComments.docs:api: Generate OpenAPI spec (with Try it out examples) and run local Swagger UI at http://localhost:8080/docs
scriptsComments.docs:api:site: Generate OpenAPI spec (with Try it out examples) and build static Swagger UI into docs/api-site/ (set PUBLIC_API_URL for Try it out)
scriptsComments.docs:api:spec: Generate OpenAPI spec and enrich request/response examples for Swagger UI prefills
scriptsComments.docs:finalize: Generate meta.json and inject provenance banners into docs/sdk and docs/api-site
scriptsComments.lint:md: Lint Markdown structure with markdownlint-cli (also part of validate)
scriptsComments.validate: Run checks: markdownlint, Vale, and Lychee (no API tests or docs / OpenAPI builds)
scriptsComments.pre-pr: Local mirror of CI PR jobs (validate + test-and-build-docs); skips main-only publish
